items.title: Keyboard-only critical workflow
evidence: 2026-09-05: User exercised the deployed v0.9.74 site without a pointing device and confirmed Tab/Space keyboard navigation worked across the tested critical workflow.

2026-09-05: Final keyboard checks also passed: player detail opened with Enter and closed with Esc without losing focus; League Setup destructive/disconnect confirmation could be reached and cancelled entirely by keyboard; Shift+Tab reverse navigation remained visible and predictable.
items.notes: Deployed critical workflow was successfully exercised keyboard-only, including forward/reverse focus navigation, player detail, and destructive-action cancellation.

items.title: Screen-reader critical workflow
items.notes: Run the critical workflow with NVDA, VoiceOver, or an equivalent assistive technology and record browser/AT versions plus any defects.

items.title: Real browser 200 percent zoom
items.notes: Spot-check all primary sections at actual 200% browser zoom. The automated 720 CSS-pixel reflow audit remains a separate deterministic gate.

items.title: Representative physical phone workflow
items.notes: Exercise navigation, player detail, waiver review, Season Plan, and League Setup on a representative physical phone/browser.

items.title: Authenticated standard ESPN league
items.notes: Validate connect, refresh, roster, matchup, lineup, waiver, change timeline, and Season Plan against a real standard-format league.

items.title: Authenticated custom FLEX or OP league
items.notes: Validate custom lineup slots, including FLEX/OP or superflex-style eligibility, without assuming unsupported slot mappings.

items.title: Authenticated acquisition and position limits
evidence: 2026-09-05: Live authenticated refresh reached ESPN roster settings but v0.9.72 rejected an unsupported roster position-limit id 6 before normalization. v0.9.73 adds fail-closed handling for unsupported unlimited/disabled limits.

2026-09-05: User retested the deployed v0.9.73 production site against the same authenticated ESPN league and confirmed Refresh ESPN completed successfully. Normalization compatibility is verified for this live roster-limit shape.

2026-09-05: User recording of League Setup after successful live refresh showed roster size 16; lineup slots QB 1, RB 2, WR 2, TE 1, D/ST 1, K 1, BE 6, IR 1, FLEX 1; finite position limits QB 4, RB 8, WR 8, TE 3, K 3, D/ST 3; season acquisition limit Unlimited; season acquisitions 0; weekly limit Unlimited; Week 1 acquisitions unavailable; waiver priority 10; processing days unavailable; budget remaining 100.

2026-09-05: Direct ESPN League Settings recording confirmed Roster Size 15, Total Starters 9, Total on Bench 6 (1 IR), and position maximums QB 4, RB 8, WR 8, TE 3, K 3, D/ST 3. ESPN acquisition settings showed Player Acquisition System Waivers, Season Acquisition Limit No Limit, Waiver Period 1 Day, and Waiver Order reset each week to inverse order of standings; the league does not use FAAB. Compared with v0.9.73 this exposed three parity defects: roster size displayed as 16, waiver period unavailable, and a phantom budget remaining 100.

2026-09-05: Deployed v0.9.74 League Setup retest matched the ESPN settings: roster size 15; finite position limits QB 4, RB 8, WR 8, TE 3, K 3, D/ST 3; player acquisition system Waivers; season and weekly limits Unlimited; waiver priority 10; waiver period 1 day; acquisition budget Not used. Week 1 acquisition usage remained unavailable rather than being inferred.

2026-09-05: Real Waivers-page recording after the v0.9.74 refresh reported no clear lineup upgrades and explicitly stated that ESPN-reported roster size and position limits were enforced and known ESPN acquisition limits and usage were checked before evaluating moves. The page retained waiver priority 10 while explicitly not predicting claim outcomes.
items.notes: Observed real ESPN acquisition settings, roster-size rules, provider-position limits, and waiver legality now match the ESPN-reported state for the tested authenticated league.

items.title: Authenticated IR edge states
items.notes: Observe supported eligible, grandfathered, filled, invalid, and/or unverified IR states as real league opportunities arise; never manufacture a live state.

items.title: Authenticated lock and availability transitions
items.notes: Observe at least one real game-lock or availability transition across refreshes and verify prior advice is revalidated or obsoleted correctly.

items.title: Real playoff and bye intelligence states
items.notes: Validate ESPN playoff-week boundaries or labeled local fallback, fantasy playoff opponents, bye coverage, and partial/full future projection behavior against real league state.

items.title: Live ESPN session or network refresh failure and reconnect
items.notes: Observe an actual expired-session, companion, ESPN service, or network failure; verify the last valid snapshot survives and reconnect/refresh guidance is accurate.

items.title: Live deployed sync revoke and delete
items.notes: Exercise encrypted mobile-sync creation plus remote revoke/delete against the deployed worker and confirm local state reflects the real outcome.

items.title: Real waiver candidate volume and timing
evidence: 2026-09-05: User recorded opening the real Waivers page after an authenticated v0.9.74 refresh and reported a small perceptible delay. Video review shows the transition from Overview to the rendered Waiver Wire completing within a few tenths of a second at 30 fps, with no visible long freeze or broken intermediate state. Candidate/scenario enumeration counts were not visible in this recording, so this performance item remains pending until those counts and timing are captured as projection coverage grows.
items.notes: Record consideredAdds, completeAdds, scenarioCount, qualifiedAdds, and observed browser responsiveness as projection coverage grows. Do not introduce a hidden candidate cap.
